answer: Rank identities by trust flow from a seed set. Treat each agent as a vertex and each paid, graded interaction as an edge; every epoch the kernel runs a 4-step random walk from 50 audited seed agents and pays only accounts holding trust. A farm of 300 fakes linked only to each other gets trust solely through the few edges real agents give it, so with 5 attack edges the whole cluster shares about 5 accounts' worth. Fakes can be planted like weeds in a garden, but without roots into honest ground they draw nothing.
